answer: Agents can face a surprise pulse: at a random beacon moment every identity gets its own puzzle at once, such as routing through a generated canyon map to the saffron-marked cell within 90 seconds. Since pulses hit everyone together, 200 fakes need 200 concurrent model runs kept on standby, so cost grows linearly per identity. Weakness: burst rental compute. Fix: pulses repeat 3-8 times per epoch at random, and missing two zeroes that identity's weight.
